questions.sentence: The final was hugely ___ and the crowd loved every minute.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective after "hugely": entertain → entertaining.

questions.sentence: She should be proud of her ___ in the tournament.
questions.explanation: After "her" we need a noun: perform → performance.

questions.sentence: It was one of the most ___ tournaments in years.
questions.explanation: After "most" we need an adjective: compete → competitive.

questions.sentence: The ___ cheered loudly when the team scored.
questions.explanation: After "the" + plural verb we need a plural noun for people: spectators.

questions.sentence: He still looks incredibly ___ for his age.
questions.explanation: After "incredibly" we need an adjective: athlete → athletic.

questions.sentence: The referee's ___ was final.
questions.explanation: After "the referee's" we need a noun: decide → decision.

questions.sentence: Running a marathon was a great ___ for me.
questions.explanation: After "a great" we need a noun: achieve → achievement.

questions.sentence: Thanks to good ___, the festival was a huge success.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: organise → organisation.

questions.sentence: The festival was very ___ and made a lot of money.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: success → successful.

questions.sentence: The ___ of people prefer to buy tickets online.
questions.explanation: "The ___ of" needs a noun: major → majority.

questions.sentence: The website lets people buy tickets ___ .
questions.explanation: We need an adverb to describe "buy": easy → easily.

questions.sentence: It was a ___ night that I'll never forget.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: memory → memorable.

questions.sentence: The ___ answered every question calmly.
questions.explanation: The person who is interviewed is the "interviewee".

questions.sentence: The song was ___ recognisable.
questions.explanation: We need an adverb before an adjective: instant → instantly.

questions.sentence: My cousin is studying to become a ___.
questions.explanation: A person who studies psychology is a "psychologist".

questions.sentence: It's ___ to drive without a seatbelt.
questions.explanation: The meaning is negative, so we add the prefix "il-".

questions.sentence: The instructions were completely ___. I couldn't follow them.
questions.explanation: The meaning is negative: un- + clear.

questions.sentence: Many people are ___ with their jobs and want to change careers.
questions.explanation: The context is negative: dissatisfied.

questions.sentence: The ___ of the new bridge took three years.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: construct → construction.

questions.sentence: Global warming is a serious ___ problem.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective before "problem": environmental.

questions.sentence: Some animals are in danger of ___.
questions.explanation: After "of" we need a noun: extinct → extinction.

questions.sentence: Solar power is a clean and ___ source of energy.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: renew → renewable.

questions.sentence: The ___ in the mountains was amazing.
questions.explanation: "Scenery" is the noun for the natural landscape.

questions.sentence: It's ___ to travel without insurance.
questions.explanation: The meaning is negative, so add the prefix "ir-".

questions.sentence: The hotel staff were very ___ and helpful.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: friend → friendly.

questions.sentence: We had a very ___ journey: the seats were hard and there was no air conditioning.
questions.explanation: The context is negative: un- + comfortable.

questions.sentence: The ___ to the museum is free on Sundays.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: admit → admission.

questions.sentence: Our flight was delayed, which was very ___.
questions.explanation: The situation causes the feeling: annoying.

questions.sentence: The guide gave a very ___ talk about the castle.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective meaning "giving information": informative.

questions.sentence: The plot was so ___ that I guessed the ending.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: predict → predictable.

questions.sentence: The book is a ___ of short stories.
questions.explanation: After "a" we need a noun: collect → collection.

questions.sentence: The novel's ___ of life in Victorian London is very vivid.
questions.explanation: After "the novel's" we need a noun: describe → description.

questions.sentence: The author's ___ is full of humour.
questions.explanation: After "the author's" we need a noun: write → writing.

questions.sentence: I found the documentary really ___.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: impress → impressive.

questions.sentence: She has a very ___ personality.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: create → creative.

questions.sentence: The new app has a lot of ___ features.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: use → useful.

questions.sentence: Eating too much sugar is ___.
questions.explanation: The meaning is negative: un- + healthy.

questions.sentence: You need a lot of ___ to run a marathon.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: determine → determination.

questions.sentence: A balanced diet should include a ___ of foods.
questions.explanation: After "a" we need a noun: vary → variety.

questions.sentence: Regular exercise improves your physical ___.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: strong → strength.

questions.sentence: He made a full ___ after his operation.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: recover → recovery.

questions.sentence: The ___ of the new phone surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: popular → popularity.

questions.sentence: The invention of the internet was a ___ moment in history.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective before "moment".

questions.sentence: Scientists made an important ___ last year.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: discover → discovery.

questions.sentence: The software is very ___ and easy to use.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: rely → reliable.

questions.sentence: Technology has changed our lives ___.
questions.explanation: We need an adverb describing "changed".

questions.sentence: There is a ___ of qualified engineers in the country.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: short → shortage.

questions.sentence: Online ___ is quick and safe.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: pay → payment.

questions.sentence: The shop assistant was very ___ and rude.
questions.explanation: The context is negative: unhelpful.

questions.sentence: The ___ of the new shopping centre was delayed.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: open → opening.

questions.sentence: The company's ___ rose by 20% last year.
questions.explanation: We need a noun; "profits" fits naturally.

questions.sentence: Her ___ in the job interview impressed everyone.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: confident → confidence.

questions.sentence: She's an ___ teacher who has worked in five countries.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective before "teacher": experienced.

questions.sentence: The company has over 500 ___.
questions.explanation: People who work for a company are "employees" (plural).

questions.sentence: We are looking for an ___ person to lead the team.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: energy → energetic.

questions.sentence: The ___ of the factory meant 200 people lost their jobs.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: close → closure.

questions.sentence: The new manager is very ___ and always listens to everyone.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: patience → patient.

questions.sentence: Working from home has many ___.
questions.explanation: We need a plural noun after "many".

questions.sentence: It's a ___ job with long hours.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: stress → stressful.

questions.sentence: The ___ of the new manager was announced today.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: appoint → appointment.

questions.sentence: The weather was ___ warm for October.
questions.explanation: We need an adverb before an adjective, with a negative prefix: unusually.

questions.sentence: The ___ was so poor that the airport closed.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: visible → visibility.

questions.sentence: After the storm there was a lot of ___ in the town.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: destroy → destruction.

questions.sentence: The weather forecast was completely ___.
questions.explanation: The context suggests a negative meaning: in- + accurate.

questions.sentence: It's ___ to see such beautiful sunsets in winter.
questions.explanation: The meaning is negative: un- + common.

questions.sentence: She is one of the most ___ journalists in the country.
questions.explanation: After "the most" we need an adjective: influential.

questions.sentence: The news story was not very ___. Nobody believed it.
questions.explanation: We need an adjective: believe → believable.

questions.sentence: The documentary was ___ in many countries.
questions.explanation: The past participle of "broadcast" is "broadcast".

questions.sentence: The ___ of the article were very interesting.
questions.explanation: We need a plural noun: conclude → conclusions.

questions.sentence: Newspapers should report the news ___.
questions.explanation: We need an adverb describing "report".

questions.sentence: She's a famous TV ___.
questions.explanation: A person who presents a TV programme is a "presenter".

questions.sentence: The ___ of the festival is a big parade.
questions.explanation: The best part of an event is the "highlight".

questions.sentence: There was a lot of ___ before the concert.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: excite → excitement.

questions.sentence: The festival has a ___ for great food.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: repute → reputation.

questions.sentence: The wedding ___ lasted all night.
questions.explanation: We need a noun: celebrate → celebration(s).

questions.sentence: All ___ in the parade must wear a costume.
questions.explanation: We need a plural noun for people: participants.

questions.sentence: The fireworks were ___ beautiful.
questions.explanation: We need an adverb before "beautiful".
